reasoning: This workflow is a sophisticated customer support automation for FairTix, a fair ticket marketplace. It monitors support emails with 'Support Request' in the subject, uses AI to classify them into 6 categories (FAQ, Account/Verification, Payment/Billing, Technical/Bug, Resale/Transfer, Feedback), and automatically responds to FAQ questions while escalating others to human agents. The workflow shows FairTix's commitment to transparent ticket sales and customer experience through automated triage and FAQ responses. The extensive classification prompt reveals deep knowledge of their business model - fair queues, resale caps, verification requirements, and transparent pricing. name: FairTix Customer Support Triage & Auto-Response
businessNarrative: This workflow automates FairTix's customer support by intelligently triaging incoming emails and automatically responding to FAQ inquiries. FairTix operates a 'fair queue' ticket marketplace that eliminates bot purchases through random selection and caps resales at face value + 20%. The system classifies support requests into six categories using Claude AI, automatically answers FAQ questions by referencing a Google Doc knowledge base, and escalates complex issues to human agents. This reveals FairTix as a customer-centric company that has systematized their support knowledge and invested in AI automation to maintain service quality while scaling operations.
trigger: Schedule trigger every minute checking for new Gmail messages with 'Support Request' in subject
dataFlow: Support emails → AI classification → FAQ content retrieval → Automated response generation → Response logging → Email reply (for FAQ) or human escalation notification (for other categories). Customer data and responses are tracked in Google Sheets for analysis.
stepName: First-line support triage and FAQ automation
